Introduction

Kawachi Maya is a Japanese rapper, singer-songwriter, and dancer under XGALX. She is best known as the lead vocalist and rapper of the Japanese global girl group XG.

Born in Kantou, Japan, Maya was never the type to participate in auditions, so she was afraid of taking on that challenge. However, when she heard of the XG auditions, she was determined to attend and be chosen; convinced that this project was nothing like anything she had done before, and intuitively felt that the project was going to be her life.

On February 2, 2022, Maya was revealed as the fifth member of XG. The group officially debuted on Mar 18, 2022, with their debut digital single "Tippy Toes".
